scenario_context: Input/worker QA only, not a climate projection: actual project Mashhad piezometers, explicitly selected existing bedrock CSV and constant Sy=0.06, four-year trend and four-year horizon; no automatic default.

climate.calendar: Persian water year: Mehr–Shahrivar; named starting year
climate.method: Regional mean September-to-September dH, >=3 common observed wells/year; OLS with secular time trend, P and T; expanding 8-year training; >=12 pairs and 4 holdouts; >=10% MAE improvement; lag 0/1 selection uses same holdouts, not independent validation; sign guard P>=0 T<=0. Association, not causal recharge or pumping attribution.

rate_trend.estimator: Theil–Sen of complete aquifer-mean Persian water years; slopes applied as changes from scenario start, not added to the historical mean

rate_audit.estimator: Theil–Sen of complete aquifer-mean Persian water years; slopes applied as changes from scenario start, not added to the historical mean
